Aim.description: An objective as a task gives it: one the device declares, by its symbol, or an expression of its outputs, with what to do with it.

expression.description: Or an expression of the outputs (`crate::device::objective`).

goal.description: `"minimize"`, `"maximize"` or `"target"`: an expression's (minimize by default), or in place of a declared objective's.

instance.description: On a chip, the device instance whose own objective (or an expression of whose own outputs) this is; `None` for an expression of the chip's outputs.

reduce.description: `"worst"`, `"average"` or `"spread"` over the band and corners; the task's when left out (a declared spread keeps its own).

target.description: The target, for a goal of `"target"`; a declared objective's own when left out.

Area.description: A rectangle in the section's plane: y across, z up, µm.

y.description: With its unit in the value, in place of y_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "1.55 um".

z.description: With its unit in the value, in place of z_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "1.55 um".

Body.description: A body in space over the structure, 3D only (docs/methods/bodies.md): a sphere, a box, an extrusion of a shape, or a union, intersection or difference of bodies, with its medium.

Bound.description: A constraint as a task gives it: one the device declares, by its symbol, or an expression of its outputs, with its bound.

expression.description: Or an expression of the outputs.

instance.description: On a chip, the device instance whose own constraint (or an expression of whose own outputs) this is: a smallest gap, a footprint; `None` for an expression of the chip's outputs.

reduce.description: `"worst"` (the default), `"average"` or `"spread"` over the band and corners.

export.description: What the run writes beside its record: its tables as CSV (`crate::export`).

from.description: With its unit in the value, in place of from_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "1.55 um".

to.description: With its unit in the value, in place of to_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "1.55 um".

center.description: As expressions in place of center_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "500 nm".

radius.description: As expressions in place of radius_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "500 nm".

Circuit.description: A chip of instances (devices of the library, or the circuit's own components), connected port to port, with its external ports.

component.description: A component of the circuit's own, in place of a device.

Component.description: A component drawn by its generator (docs/methods/generators.md): its type (straight, bend, taper, mmi, directional coupler, ring, grating coupler, ...) and that type's fields; name, layer, etch, origin, rotate, mirror and connect for any of them.

layer.description: The layer it is drawn on: the task's by default.

name.description: Its name, by which its ports are found: "name.port".

generations.description: Each stage's budget of generations; a stage ends when the method converges without one.

keep.description: "state" (the default: the optimizer's state goes on) or "point" (it starts again).

parameter.description: The parameter each stage sets: one the design names, or a new name the expressions use.

values.description: Its value at each stage, 2 to 64 of them.

ConvergenceSpec.description: A modes job's `[task.convergence]`: the grid study behind each mode's effective index. The modes are solved again on grids each twice as coarse, and the task's grid's Re n_eff, the number reported, is checked by `crate::convergence::Study::check`.

grids.description: How many grids, the task's among them: 2 (a first-order estimate) or 3 (Richardson's, the default).

require.description: Fail the run when a mode's grid hasn't converged (by default its record says so and the run goes on).

tolerance.description: The tolerance on each Re n_eff's estimated error.

CrosstalkSpec.description: `[task.crosstalk]`: a heater array's steady response and the phases wanted of it.

bias.description: Each shifter's phase with no power, rad (0 by default). With its unit in the value, in place of bias_rad: an angle with its unit, e.g. "0.5 rad".

bias_rad.description: Each shifter's phase with no power, rad (0 by default).

count.description: Gurses et al.'s row: how many shifters.

max_power_mw.description: What each heater stands, mW: every power's upper bound.

neighbour_p_pi_mw.description: Gurses et al.'s row: the power for π on the n-th neighbour, mW, n = 1, 2, …

p_pi_mw.description: Gurses et al.'s row: each heater's power for π on its own shifter, mW.

phase_per_watt.description: The steady response, rad/W: `phase_per_watt[i][j]`, shifter i's phase per W of heater j (a static job's thermal model's residues summed, or its dn_eff/dP times 2π/λ).

target.description: Each shifter's wanted phase, rad. With its unit in the value, in place of target_rad: an angle with its unit, e.g. "0.5 rad".

method.description: genoxide's method: lbfgsb, adam, mma, gcmma, nelder-mead, cmaes, de, pso.

grids.description: How many grids, the task's among them: 2 or 3 (the default).

require.description: Fail the run when Vπ·L's grid hasn't converged.

tolerance.description: The tolerance on Vπ·L's estimated error, V·cm.

entry.description: The catalogue entry whose tensor it takes, e.g. `"linbo3"`.

layer.description: The stack layer the crystal is, its material an oriented catalogue crystal.

polarization.description: `"te"` (the default) or `"tm"`: of the two highest modes, the one more TE (or TM).

resolve.description: Whether to solve the perturbed cross-section again (true by default).

static_permittivity.description: `"clamped"` (ε^S, the default) or `"unclamped"` (ε^T): the crystal's static permittivity when `[task.permittivity]` doesn't give it.

step.description: The mode's step, nm. With its unit in the value, in place of step_nm: a length with its unit, e.g. "20 nm".

tensor.description: The tensor's label in the entry, e.g. `"thin film (x-cut LNOI), clamped, 1550 nm"`.

wavelength.description: The light's wavelength, µm. With its unit in the value, in place of wavelength_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "1.55 um".

y.description: The mode's window across (y) and up (z), µm. With its unit in the value, in place of y_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "1.55 um".

y_um.description: The mode's window across (y) and up (z), µm.

z.description: With its unit in the value, in place of z_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "1.55 um".

EtchSpec.description: A shape's `etch = { depth_um, sidewall_deg }` (`crate::stack::Etch`): how deep from its layer's top (through it when left out) and its walls' angle from the layer's plane (90 when left out). `depth` and `sidewall` take expressions with units (`"70 nm"`, `"85 deg"`).

depth.description: As expressions in place of depth_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "500 nm".

sidewall.description: As expressions in place of sidewall_deg: an angle with its unit, e.g. "90 deg".

ExportSpec.description: A job's `[task.export]`: what its run writes into its directory beside `events.jsonl` (`crate::export`). A job without one writes every table its run has, as CSV, and no fields.

compression.description: The npz's compression: `"deflate"` (the default, photonoxide's own) or `"zstd"` (Zstandard, from the user's own libzstd, loaded at run time: docs/libraries.md).

container.description: The fields' file: `"npz"` (the default, NumPy's, photonoxide's own) or `"hdf5"` (an `.h5` of the same arrays, from the user's own libhdf5, loaded at run time).

fields.description: Which fields: `"Ex"`, `"Ey"`, `"Ez"`, `"Hx"`, `"Hy"`, `"Hz"`, `"temperature"`, `"potential"`; every one the kind computes by default.

format.description: `"csv"` (the tables), `"npz"` (the fields), `"both"` or `"none"`: `"both"` when `fields` is given, `"csv"` otherwise.

level.description: The compression level: deflate's 0 (store) to 9 (smallest), 6 by default; Zstandard's 1 to 22, 3 by default. The csv is never compressed.

precision.description: `"f32"` or `"f64"` (the default): the npz's fields' precision (the grids and the small numbers stay `f64`).

tables.description: Which tables, by name: `"modes"`, `"sweep"`, `"s_parameters"`, `"spectra"`, `"resonances"`, `"study"`, `"history"`, `"static"`, `"transient"`; every one the run has by default.

Expression.description: An expression of numbers with units and the task's parameters (docs/methods/expressions.md), e.g. "500 nm", "w/2 + gap", "10 deg".

averaging.description: How the plane's cells are averaged (`crate::averaging::Averaging`): `"samples"` (the default), `"point"`, `"mean"`, `"diagonal"` or `"tensor"`.

bottom_oxide.description: With its unit in the value, in place of bottom_oxide_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "1.55 um".

cell.description: Named groups of shapes, placed by a [[task.shape]] of type "reference".

core.description: With its unit in the value, in place of core_nm: a length with its unit, e.g. "20 nm".

export.description: What the run writes beside its record: the tables, and the field at `field_um` as an npz when asked (`crate::export`).

field.description: The field is recorded at the swept wavelength nearest this (µm): the first by default. With its unit in the value, in place of field_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "1.55 um".

field_um.description: The field is recorded at the swept wavelength nearest this (µm): the first by default.

pml_cells.description: PML cells on each side, inside the window: 20 by default.

polarization.description: `"te"` (the default) or `"tm"`: the slab mode's polarization.

shapes.description: Shapes one to a line, each its type and its fields: - rect: { layer: Si, center_um: [0, 0], size_um: [6, 0.5] }. A rect, circle, ring or path is one of [[task.rect]], [[task.circle]], [[task.ring]] or [[task.path]]; any other type a [[task.shape]] of it.

wavelength.description: With its unit in the value, in place of wavelength_um: a length with its unit, e.g. "1.55 um".
